# Show premounting in the Studio timeline<AvailableFrom v="4.0.535" />

Show premounting indicators in the Studio timeline. Defaults to `true`; this may change in a future 4.x release. Set explicitly to preserve your preference.

## CLI flag

```text
--show-premounting
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setShowPremounting(false);
```
